recent_chronicle.title: Transplant Research Finalized, Then Reopened as Ollama Fails and Z Scores Spike
recent_chronicle.blurb: Background research and league maintenance both failed with repeated Ollama errors—read timeouts, a 500 Internal Server Error, and a JSON decode error—while CosmoWanda top-20 hold_time_dispersion spiked to z=32.0 and top-50 avg_roi diverged to z=24.2. Answers were finalized on which live-strategy layers to transplant into Downforce and Jade and on the parameter mapping required, but the implementation checklist question was reopened the same day and paired with a new inquiry into rollback safeguards for live trade-entry hooks. The system knowledge index absorbed fifty-two new or refreshed entries, reaching 561.

generated_overview: The official 24/7 league is in a defensive consolidation phase. Cosmo & Wanda variants book perfect win rates on closed trades but hemorrhage paper gains through concentrated open-trade exposure, leaving the Top 50 entry with a nominal equity lead (~$1,068) yet fragile post-restart lineage, while the Top 20 incumbent sits at exact net-zero realized-versus-unrealized parity. Timmy strategies continue to exhibit the league’s cleanest telemetry and genuine shortfall acceptance, with the Top 50 prospect bleeding slowly (~$8.35 net) across 139 trades and the Top 20 variant deeper underwater (~$25.46) despite a modest hit-rate advantage. The central tension remains unresolved: C&W’s unrealized inventory risk versus Timmy’s realized-cost erosion, with neither family currently demonstrating sustainable net expectancy.
